central_ecological_question: On the SAME physical Terceira native-forest plots, do woody plant and endemic beetle assemblages show congruent spatial turnover beyond shared geographic distance, or do the taxonomic assemblages respond differently to spatial habitat structure?
biogeographic_unit: 10 Terceira 50x50m native forest plots; separate Pico beetle, Tenerife/Réunion tree plots are NOT matched and cannot be pooled

woody.sampling_semantics: Tree/shrub shoots DBH>=1cm; sampling methods and sampling grain not directly comparable to beetle COBRA

beetles.sampling_semantics: COBRA standardized multiple sampling methods; 308 Events are nested within 16 permanent plots, not independently replicated forest patches

metadata_protocol: Download exact original v1.7 tree archive (sha fixed from old v1.283 original response-opaque receipt) and exact v1.3 beetle archive, each <=500KB.
Inspect only ZIP directory and original meta.xml XML field names / Darwin Core core and extension roles, no Event data, no Occurrence rows, taxon names or beetle counts
Emit beetle original SHA256 so a later Event-only crosswalk can pin both source bytes
Require both Event core id index, Occurrence extension coreid index, and Event locationID plus island, samplingProtocol or eventID, elevation and coordinates where present
DO NOT infer plot equivalence from shared project title alone; next v1.298 must establish exact bijection on ten source site identities without plant/beetle response access

crosswalk_grammar_frozen_before_event_va.primary: Normalize original Event locationID by retaining only A-Z, 0-9 and uppercasing, e.g. TER_NFBF_T01 / TER-NFBF-T-01 map to TERNFBFT01
crosswalk_grammar_frozen_before_event_va.secondary: Original eventID and locality may be reported as raw field presence only in first metadata pass. Do not use as fallback without a NEW response-sealed contract if locationID fails.
crosswalk_grammar_frozen_before_event_va.coordinates_secondary_audit: If present, require latitude and longitude differences <=0.0003 degrees (~30m) between matched original author sites; 2012 and 2013 may have plot-coordinate rounding

candidate_analysis_if_and_only_if_event_.plot_population: Exactly 10 matched Terceira plots, each one natural forest 50x50m, excluding all unmatched plots without viewing species labels
candidate_analysis_if_and_only_if_event_.response_plan: Test cross-taxon similarity of woody assemblage and endemic beetle assemblage turnover on the original 45 unordered plot pairs. Compare distance-based community dissimilarities controlling geographic distances and fixed effort, using permutation of 10 plot labels as genuine unit, never treating 45 edges as independent trials.
candidate_analysis_if_and_only_if_event_.novel_potential: Same-site cross-kingdom concordance or decoupling can connect habitat filtering and beetle communities on islands; expected concordance not assumed.
candidate_analysis_if_and_only_if_event_.inferential_limit: At most one island/10 plots, source published ecological prior art, not proof of causal plant-to-beetle interaction, dispersal routes or cross-archipelago generality. Original tree data across Tenerife/Reunion cannot be used to fabricate beetle replication.

admission_stop: Exact author plot-ID overlap fewer than 10/10
Materially unequal beetle survey methods/effort across ten plots without a feasible response-independent subset
Unexpected archive/version schema or any original ID reused across different sites
Taxon statuses or woody/beetle species endpoints unobserved or not physically meaningful
